reviews.text: A veterinary center with competent staff. Our dog is being treated by them, and they've solved virtually all of his health problems. The doctors and staff are kind and clearly know how to treat both patients and their owners. They examine all kinds of animals, including dogs, cats, turtles, and more. A highly recommended place if you care about the health of your furry friends. We'd especially like to thank Dr. Freri for her expertise.

Easy to get to. Highly qualified staff, air-conditioned environment with large outdoor spaces, and a vending machine offering coffee, crisps, sweets, and water, all of which are essential. From reception to checkout, highly qualified staff welcome dogs, cats, and any other pets.
Very positive

I waited a few days before writing. I'm doing so solely to share my experience and offer a perspective that may help you be very careful when choosing this facility.

Below is a summary of the facts.

I had a kitten of about 4 months who had been panting for a few days. On Monday, June 22, 2026, my wife took him to the emergency room of this clinic.

An X-ray was performed, and the kitten's lungs were found to be compromised. We were advised to administer a "pipette antiparasitic, as it is almost certainly a case of parasites that have invaded the lungs."

We were advised to have fecal tests, but unfortunately, since we don't have much money, we chose to proceed as recommended by the doctor on duty (€105, invoice received by email but no report or X-rays), trusting her opinion.

We were told that the kitten might worsen after the medication was administered and recommended a day hospital stay with them, which we agreed to do (cost €95, invoice received but no report).

Upon discharge, we were told to refill the antiparasitic pipette in 30 days, but were given no further instructions or treatment.

The kitten's condition worsened. During the night between June 24th and 25th, 2026, his agony became excruciating. We called them and were advised of the possibility of undergoing oxygen therapy there (total €150 per day). We also consulted two other veterinarians outside the clinic, but they advised us to return to the clinic for oxygen therapy.

Unfortunately (as a father of two children and a rent-paying bill), my financial resources were too low to cover these expenses. We sought advice on what to do, but received none.

At 5:30 a.m. on June 25, 2026, the kitten was dying. I rushed him to the clinic's emergency room. Two young doctors attempted resuscitation, but I asked them not to cause him any further suffering, and the poor thing died.

When I told them, "You gave him back to us in serious condition without providing any treatment or real advice, and no one even came forward to put an end to his possible agony," the doctor replied (among other sad things, but I'll summarize) in a pedantic manner, "Animals have become luxury goods. If you can't afford them, don't take them." I made it very clear that I felt this was all unfair and inconsistent with the profession one has chosen.

The next day, I emailed them to request the X-ray reports and to write in detail about what had happened. No response.

I call the office with the same request. The secretary (the only kind and understanding person I've ever dealt with there) is having trouble finding the report. She tells me she'll call me back. But nothing happens.

I send a certified email to the attention of management. Dr. Selleri calls and invites me to explain what happened over the phone. He tells me he's very sorry and will send me all the documentation.

The documents don't arrive. I invite the doctor via WhatsApp to send me the report and the x-rays. The doctor sends me a WhatsApp message with a summary of "what happened," written by him on the spot, pretending to be the report.

The next day, I ask for x-rays again. They finally arrive by email (still without any report).

I call the office again to request the report. The secretary tries to find it, but it's still missing.

That's it as of June 28, 2026.

I'm considering pursuing other avenues, but with the sole aim of not remaining silent in the face of a blatant case of injustice.

What deeply pains me (I've always had well-cared-for animals, and this is the first time I've found myself in a situation like this):
- the fate of the poor kitten
- no veterinarian in this story has been able to intervene to at least alleviate his suffering
- that I'm being mocked in this way when I'm requesting documents that are my right and their duty to provide.

Four people were terrible at giving a cat a shot. Absolutely avoid them. They have no empathy for treating cats. He was traumatized. Extremely high and non-transparent prices. They insisted I keep him under surveillance all night with tubes attached for "possible crystals." A 3-year-old cat was completely fine, drinking a lot, and never had any urinary problems, even after being checked by my trusted vet. They'll do anything to get their hands on him so they can ask for money.
Very professional
Fast, helpful, and professional. The cost is comparable to any veterinary clinic.
Competent and good veterinarians
Everyone was very polite and welcoming. I brought my budgerigar and the vet was professional, understanding, and kind. :) I'm happy to have found such a clinic.
Definitely a lot of professionalism
Gorgeous and kind

I had a terrible experience. They want to make a shameful profit on every little thing. Highly recommended for pets and exotic animals. Never again. They almost asked me for money, even because I had crossed their threshold. Terrible, terrible, terrible.

A difficult night, a sudden emergency 💔. Within minutes, the surgeon and anesthesiologist were at our side, calm, ready, and competent. There were many dogs and people around, but only serenity, empathy, and respect. I saw true professionalism and big hearts. Heartfelt thanks to those who do this job with passion and humanity 💚🐾
Very kind, empathetic, and knowledgeable staff. A great experience!
Thank you! ❤️

I came to the clinic and told her that my parrot was very, very sick. The woman at the front desk called the doctor immediately instead. I chatted and laughed for 15 minutes! My parrot is dead! I demand that the clinic administration punish this woman for her irresponsible behavior! Maybe my parrot could have been saved!

And the doctor was very kind, and I have no complaints about him.
Excellent clinic, competent and professional doctors.
Good clinic and everyone is kind and very good.
Good welcome, very busy.

Personally, I had a terrible experience. I went to this clinic sent by my trusted vet after having my dog ​​undergone a CT scan following a diagnosis of oral osteosarcoma. We visited Dr. Schiano, whom we haven't seen or heard from since bringing us the results of the CT scan, performed at the Cetego center (very good). They even took care of giving us the lymph nodes removed during the scan and the corresponding disk, to give to Dr. Schiano. Not only did we not hear from anyone again, but after insisting, we were given an appointment with Dr. Sontuoso, who, in agreement with Dr. Schiano, planned to perform a new operation on the affected area, to prevent a possible recurrence. During the visit, it became clear that the lymph nodes taken had not been examined, much less the disk, which, when we requested, we were told was not available at the time. It was therefore clear that the only interest was in performing surgery and that no one had examined the CT scan results. A truly terrible experience, with the doctors demonstrating a very poor level of professionalism.

I finally found a veterinary clinic with good, competent veterinarians for exotic animals, especially snakes.
The clinic is beautiful, clean, welcoming, and punctual. There are several vets, and the costs are fair, in my opinion. Fortunately, I've never needed emergency veterinary care until now, but the fact that they also have one gives me even more peace of mind. I finally got to know Dr. Marco Masi, who is truly helpful and, of course, having been highly recommended by reptile breeders as the best in this field, I can only say that so far he has given me peace of mind and reliability.
In short, it's a clinic I'll gladly return to with all my animals, even if they're quite far from my home, but I prefer the security of a location.

Our boxer Polly stayed at this facility for six days. She underwent emergency surgery for a pneumothorax caused by a foxtail. We found the staff to be super professional, kind, and helpful. Thank you all.

CVS is a competent and safe place to bring your pets, especially those classified as exotic. The staff is competent, qualified, and helpful. Many tests are performed directly in the clinic, avoiding long waits, and the center employs many experts specializing in various veterinary disciplines. The staff also includes surgeons, and the center regularly performs scheduled and emergency procedures. My go-to person is Dr. Bergamasco, who is highly knowledgeable, very kind, and helpful, and extremely attentive in caring for her patients.
The only veterinarian with highly competent professionals
Thanks to Dr. Cristina Menicocci, a good and competent human being.
Dr. Boccuzzi's professionalism reassures us in the care of our little rabbit.
Friendly and very competent staff

I had a great experience even though my bunny underwent an invasive operation. 100% professionalism, good and competent staff kept me constantly updated on the health of my furry friend. The operation was a great success. Thank you so much for how everything went.
Went for work, delivered injured animal.
They are excellent at their work....for those who have animals, I recommend bringing your puppies and adults to visit this clinic, open 24 hours a day.
It's undoubtedly expensive, but the staff are excellent and patient with the animals and especially the owners! I've seen them treat and save truly desperate cases. Recommended for parrots.

We went on a Saturday without an appointment to have our elderly hamster examined. The staff was very kind, the wait could have been worse, and the prices were very fair. The doctor who treated our beloved Arthur (the hamster) seemed knowledgeable and gave us lots of helpful advice, as well as the treatment plan. We'll see... for now, 5 stars.
Well done, very kind and efficient
Trust your little ones to Guendalini ophthalmologist. He's the best in Italy, and above all, he's empathetic and kind.

A clinic and emergency room for animals.
It's an excellent facility with veterinarians specializing in various fields. Everything was well organized, efficient, and professional.
We took our dog for an eye exam and surgery.
Highly recommended.

As always...really good!!
The clinic that takes care of your pet, with love.
Excellent service and kindness both for our animal friends and for us and also great professionalism from all the staff

I went to them years ago, and they saved my bunny thanks to a very delicate operation performed by the excellent Dr. Paolo Selleri. My bunny also received treatment from Dr. Masi, who is also very skilled, competent, and, in my opinion, loving with animals. The cost was fair, considering all the assistance before and after the operation, and also the difficulty of the procedure. They intervened immediately, and my bunny has no more bladder problems... Today, thanks in part to their advice, my bunny is 13 years old!

Dr. Valerio Larosa is excellent, very competent and reassuring, he immediately understood what was wrong with our dog and acted immediately to help... the veterinary clinic is open 24 hours a day, very helpful... I highly recommend it.
